Body.Content:
Some of the most commonly used business processes that project managers perform during subcontract management include the following tasks:

Modify subcontract line

Track subcontract usage

Monitor billing progress for subcontracts

Currently, project managers need to use multiple forms and interfaces to access these business processes. This complexity increases when project managers manage vendors and subcontracts across various projects.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/pro/subcontracting/improved-sub-contracting-ui-experience

GA date: August CY2027

Preview date: September CY2025
